skill.summary: Helps managers prepare structured 1:1 meeting agendas focusing on priorities, blockers, feedback, growth, and follow-up actions.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – structures effective manager one-on-one prep

- Guides 1:1 meeting prep around priorities, blockers, feedback, and growth
- Delivers organized agenda, talking points, and follow-up actions
- Includes safety boundaries against manipulation and legal/HR advice
- Requires meeting goal, project updates, blockers, feedback topics, and relationship context as input
- Suggests questions for alignment and professional growth
